Hi Liam / AvaCorp procurement team,

Thanks again for a constructive discovery call today. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we discussed — file: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx. High level recap and suggested milestones below so we have a single view of responsibilities and timing.

Proposed headline timeline (open to alignment):
- Customer legal review complete: target 2026-07-08 (owner: AvaCorp Legal)
- Pricing & procurement sign-off / PO issuance: target 2026-07-20 (owner: AvaCorp Procurement)
- Redwood SOW finalization and signing: target 2026-07-22 (owner: Redwood / Camila)
- Pilot kickoff: 2026-08-02 (owner: Customer Success)

Key dependencies we called out on the call:
- Your internal legal needs the PROD/PERF security appendix (attached in SOW_Draft_0618.pdf)
- Procurement requires an approved budget line and PO template — can you share the PO cadence / any required SLA clauses?

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the MAP draft and add any missing milestones or edits directly in the spreadsheet by EOD 2026-07-02.
2) I will route our SOW to legal on 2026-07-01 so you have Redwood-side redlines by 2026-07-05.
3) Schedule a short sync (15 min) on 2026-07-06 if there are outstanding legal/PO questions.

If procurement needs an earlier signature target, please flag the date you need so we can assess internal approvals and any commercial accommodations.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive

Camila — thanks for the summary and the draft MAP. Quick clarifications from procurement/legal after our side-by-side:

- Legal has requested the PROD/PERF appendix and expects to complete review by 2026-07-08.
- Procurement needs the PO raised by 2026-07-20 to hit our end-of-month budget cutoff. If the PO is later than 2026-07-20 our approval window slips to August.
- Can Redwood commit to final SOW sign-off no later than 48 hours after we issue the PO? That will help our internal vendors map onboarding timelines.

We'd prefer the target contract signature date to be 2026-07-22 as you proposed, but the controlling date for us is the PO issuance (2026-07-20). If Redwood needs an earlier contractual signature to meet commercial terms, let us know.

Also attaching a sample PO template for your legal team to confirm there are no showstoppers.

Thanks — Liam
